title: Quality Metric
description: One quality metric a plugin computed for a recording. Plugin manifests (nemar-cli shared/contract) declare each metric output with this shape.

value.description: The metric's value; null when it could not be computed.

unit.description: Unit of the value (for example %, dB, count).

description.description: One-sentence description of what the metric measures.

bounds.description: The valid range the plugin declares for this value (not a quality threshold).

plugin.description: The plugin that produced this value.
